changes.value: All new headline/body copy is still routed through the existing {{cms:...}} token system, with SITE_CONTENT_SCHEMA in server.py updated to match the new sections, so the admin Site Contents page keeps working for the new copy.
Visitors browse a handful of times to decide, then register once — not a daily-use surface.
Nothing on the public page is destructive; no confirmation dialogs needed outside the existing registration/payment flows, which are out of scope for this redesign.

Home, Services, How It Works and Industries remain anchor-linked sections on one continuous page, matching both the current site's architecture (nav already uses #anchor links) and the mockup's continuous scroll layout.

The integrations logo strip, the detailed invoice-approval workspace demo, and the FAQ accordion from the current page are restyled to the new identity and kept, slotted in below the mockup's Services/How-it-works/Industries sections rather than dropped.

Brand accent sampled directly from the supplied logo/ad: #27F997 (logo mark, "buinee.app" wordmark) and #48EE94 (ad CTA pill) — the same hue family. A deeper, text-safe shade is derived for links/body copy on light backgrounds to meet 4.5:1 contrast; the bright mint is reserved for buttons, badges and icon fills on dark or white surfaces.
Headlines ("Stop spending time formatting and doing reports.") are set in a bold sans, not the current site's serif display face.

Light sections sample as pure white (#FFFFFF) page background with #F8F9FA card surfaces — a neutral palette, replacing the current site's warm cream (#F6F4EF/#EFECE5). Dark sections (hero, footer, testimonial band) sample near-black with a faint green cast (~#000B0F), close to the current dark theme's existing tokens, so the dark side of the palette carries over largely unchanged.
Every new section reflows to a clean single-column mobile layout; nothing is hidden or degraded on phone.
Full keyboard operation, visible focus states, 4.5:1 text contrast (driving the deeper green text token in PG-003), labelled controls.
